slots.purpose: Hero: shows the article's promise at a glance, a real beach ceremony set up on the sand at Punta Cana.
slots.shot_brief: Licensed or owned photo of a real wedding ceremony setup on a beach in Punta Cana (La Altagracia province, Dominican Republic): aisle and chairs on pale sand, a simple floral arch or chuppah-style frame, turquoise water and coconut palms behind. Late afternoon light, before guests are seated (no people, or the couple from behind only with signed consent). No resort signage, umbrellas, towels or logos in frame. Wide 3:2 with headroom for a title crop. Location must be verified by the register, EXIF GPS or the photographer's named gallery. Record the month taken so the caption and any season reference are true.

slots.purpose: Show what an evening reception on the beachfront looks like, supporting the planning and atmosphere section.
slots.shot_brief: Licensed or owned photo of a real beachfront wedding reception in Punta Cana at dusk: long or round dressed tables on sand or a beachside deck, candles and festoon or lantern lighting, sky in blue hour. No identifiable guests unless the register records consent. No resort branding, logos or signage on linen, menus or structures. Landscape 3:2. Location verified (register, EXIF GPS or photographer gallery) and month taken recorded.

slots.purpose: Illustrate the guest experience section: arrivals or a welcome event at a Punta Cana resort, showing the multi-day nature of a destination wedding.
slots.shot_brief: Licensed or owned photo of guests arriving or gathering at a welcome drinks event at a real resort in Punta Cana: welcome cocktails, tropical florals or a palm-lined terrace, golden hour. People shown from behind, in soft focus or at distance so no one is identifiable, unless the register records written guest consent. No children identifiable. No resort name, logo, wristbands or signage visible. Landscape 3:2. Location verified (register, EXIF GPS or photographer gallery) and month taken recorded.

slots.purpose: Support the weather and hurricane-season section with a real shaded or covered alternative ceremony space (the backup plan couples should ask venues about).
slots.shot_brief: Licensed or owned photo of a real covered or shaded ceremony space in Punta Cana: an open-sided gazebo, palapa or pergola, or a covered terrace dressed for a ceremony, with the beach or gardens visible beyond. No people or not identifiable. No resort branding or logos. Landscape 3:2. Location verified (register, EXIF GPS or photographer gallery) and month taken recorded. If the image shows rain or storm conditions, the caption must not imply a season unless the month is known.
